title: Li's criterion for the Riemann Hypothesis
summary: Li's criterion for the Riemann zeta function, formalized in Lean 4 over Mathlib: Mathlib's `RiemannHypothesis` holds if and only if every Li-Keiper coefficient of the completed xi function has nonnegative real part. The zero-indexed analytic coefficient at n is Li's classical lambda_(n+1), the n-th Taylor coefficient at 0 of the logarithmic derivative of s |-> xi(1/(1-s)).
